rounds.text: Paushak Ltd is showing powerful underlying momentum with trailing twelve-month compounded sales growth accelerating to 15% [E17] and recent screen triggers highlighting robust YoY surges in sales and net profits [E63, E65]. Crucially, capital deployment has reached a major inflection point as Capital Work-in-Progress (CWIP) dropped by 86.3% to Rs 26 Cr [E40], signaling that heavy capex has completed and new revenue-generating capacity is coming online. Operational cash generation remains exceptionally healthy, backed by a strong cash conversion of 1.38x where profits are fully backed by cash [E34], alongside Rs 54 Cr in operating cash flow [E35] representing 97% of operating profit [E37]. Furthermore, the business operates with a conservative debt-to-equity ratio of 0.16x [E38] while benefiting from a solid macroeconomic tailwind in the chemicals sector, which boasts a positive tailwind score of 0.76 to 0.77 [E72, E74]. Promoter confidence is firm with a slight increase in holdings to 67.28% [E41], and relative-strength against the Nifty 500 hits the maximum possible rating of 100 [E51]. Conceded: the reverse DCF indicates today's price already implies 16.1% earnings growth [E47], trailing return on equity sits at a low 7% [E29], and institutional money flow registers as negative [E44].
